title: verify() now parameter now explicit for testability
description: verify() takes an explicit 'now: SystemTime' parameter rather than calling SystemTime::now() internally. This is the correct design: the test suite passes a fixed time within the cert validity window (UNIX_EPOCH + 1_893_456_000), making tests deterministic and non-expiring. A contributor might suggest removing it to simplify the API, but this would re-introduce a time-bomb in every test that uses real certificates.
close_reason: P3 opinion/style: no correctness issue, deferred.
